theater: 佩滕低地與烏蘇馬辛塔河谷

battle.name: 西亞吉·卡克的征服
battle.theater: 佩滕低地與烏蘇馬辛塔河谷
battle.brief: 公元378年，蒂卡爾新王西亞吉·卡克發兵攻入亞克奇蘭，國王鳥美洲豹四世戰死，王儲被俘，次年聯軍再滅瓦卡，佩滕從此歸於蒂卡爾一人之下。卡面的羅馬方陣盾並不在此役現場：同時代的馬雅戰士裝備的是小型皮盾、矛投器長矛與木劍，攻守之道全不同。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 公元378至379年間，中美洲佩滕低地爆發了一場改寫整個馬雅世界權力版圖的戰爭。交戰主體是蒂卡爾王國及其同盟城邦聯盟，對手則是曾經稱霸佩滕的瓦卡（今日稱埃爾米拉多爾）與亞克奇蘭的舊王室。蒂卡爾一方的指揮體系並非中央集權的常備軍國家：國王西亞吉·卡克是唯一握有兵權的統帥，出征時以「星戰」的名義集合附庸與盟友的兵員，烏亞克通、埃爾佐茲、貝胡卡爾等城邦各自出兵，由地方首領率領，這些首領多帶有「納科姆」一類的戰時頭銜，並由祭司集團以曆法卜算決定發兵的日子與陣形。瓦卡與亞克奇蘭一方則維持舊有的城邦聯盟體系，兩地都曾是特奧蒂瓦坎在南部低地的代理與前哨。值得注意的是，戰爭列表把特奧蒂瓦坎也列在交戰一方，反映的正是這場衝突真正的主題：特奧蒂瓦坎自六世紀起對馬雅低地的干預正在退潮，原有代理秩序崩解，留下的真空由蒂卡爾這個新王朝來填補。整場衝突沒有留下逐日戰報，參與者的編組只能靠蒂卡爾與亞克奇蘭兩地的紀念碑、附屬小國的碑刻以及近年的碳十四定年拼湊，因此上述同盟名單大致可信，具體的出動兵員與各城邦的貢獻比例則無從核實。
countriesEn: Between 378 and 379 AD the lowland forest of Petén, in Mesoamerica, was the scene of a war that redrew the balance of power across the entire Maya world. The main belligerents were the kingdom of Tikal and a coalition of its allied city-states on one side, and on the other the former hegemon of Petén, Waka' (known today as El Mirador), together with the older ruling house of Yaxchilán. Tikal's command system was not that of a centralised state with a standing army: King Siyaj K'ak' was the only commander holding the reins of war, and he mustered the contingents of his vassals and allies under the name of a star war, with Uaxactún, El Zotz and Bejucal each sending their own troops under local leaders who bore titles of the war-leader kind such as naacom, while a priestly group fixed the date and the order of battle by calendrical divination. The Waka'-Yaxchilán side preserved the older city-state league structure, and both cities had long served as proxies and outposts of Teotihuacan in the southern lowlands. It is worth noting that the war lists also place Teotihuacan among the belligerents, and that this captures the true theme of the conflict: Teotihuacan's six-century-old intervention in the Maya lowlands was in retreat, the old order of proxies was coming apart, and the vacuum it left was being filled by the new dynasty at Tikal. The war left no day-by-day account; the composition of the sides has to be reconstructed from the monuments of Tikal and Yaxchilán, from stelae of the smaller vassal states and from recent radiocarbon dating. The list of participants above is therefore broadly reliable, while the specific numbers of troops and each city's contribution cannot be checked.
people: 這場戰爭留下來的人名不多，但每一個都刻在石頭上。蒂卡爾王西亞吉·卡克是整件事的策動者，他於公元378年即位；他父親的名號帶著源自特奧蒂瓦坎的地名（瓦哈特佩克一系），顯示蒂卡爾上一代曾深度依附中美洲最大城邦的勢力。西亞吉·卡克即位後改用「K'inich Yax Ahaw」這類帶有日月神聖色彩的尊號，宣告新王朝脫離舊框架，同年即揮兵東進亞克奇蘭。亞克奇蘭的國王鳥美洲豹四世是另一端的主角，他在亞克奇蘭的門楣與石碑上被刻成身佩長矛、腳踏敵陣的戰士形象；這次戰役中他陣亡於戰陣，其年幼的兒子，也就是後來登基的盾牌美洲豹二世，被生擒並押回蒂卡爾；王室貴婦大頭顱（K'awiil）與一名女兒同時淪為俘虜。亞克奇蘭第11號石碑上那個被勒頸而倒伏的身影，即是戰敗國王的定格。為死者立碑的是三百多年後的第三代國王鳥美洲豹三世，他於公元790年前後命工匠在球場側刻成第11號石碑；第25號門楣則刻出蒂卡爾君主攜著俘虜小王儲的形象，並列立大頭顱夫人。今天這些石刻多藏於瓜地馬拉國家考古與民族學博物館，也應記得第25號門楣曾於1966年被盜往海外，直到1990年代才回歸本國。
peopleEn: Few names survive from this war, but every one of them is cut into stone. Siyaj K'ak', king of Tikal, set the whole business in motion: he acceded in 378 AD, and the name of his father carried a toponym of Teotihuacan origin (of the Waxtepec family), showing that the previous generation at Tikal had been deeply tied to the largest city-state of Mesoamerica. Siyaj K'ak' adopted a title of the sacred solar-lunar kind, K'inich Yax Ahaw, and by that act announced a dynasty breaking with the old framework; in the same year he marched east against Yaxchilán. Bird Jaguar IV, king of Yaxchilán, is the principal figure on the other side; on the lintels and stelae of his city he is carved as a warrior with a long spear, standing over the fallen enemy. In this campaign he was killed in the field, and his small son, who was later to rule as Shield Jaguar II, was taken alive and carried off to Tikal; the king's wife known as Lady Great Skull (K'awiil) and one of the daughters were taken at the same time. The figure being throttled and toppled on Yaxchilán Stela 11 is the defeated king fixed in stone. It was the third ruler of the dynasty, Bird Jaguar III, who had the monument carved some three hundred years later, commissioning Stela 11 beside the ballcourt around 790 AD; Lintel 25 shows the Tikal ruler holding the captive boy-prince, with Lady Great Skull standing beside them. Most of these monuments are today in the Museo Nacional de Arqueología y Etnología in Guatemala, and it should be remembered that Lintel 25 was stolen abroad in 1966 and only returned to its country in the 1990s.
kits: 這張卡掛著的是羅馬方陣盾，而它在這場戰爭裡的位置必須老實說清楚：中美洲從未出現過羅馬方陣盾，公元378年的佩滕戰場上沒有任何一件羅馬兵裝出現。作為對照，馬雅戰士手中的防護器具是小型的圓形或橢圓形手盾，以木條與藤編骨架蒙上獸皮，邊緣可嵌黑曜石碎片，握在手中掩護上半身而非覆蓋全身；與羅馬軍團百人隊那種一人高的凸面長方盾相比，差距不在工藝而在戰役體制：羅馬靠盾緣相咬排成密集橫列與龜甲陣，馬雅則靠精銳步兵的密集列陣與投射武器的射擊節奏。進攻武器方面，馬雅人不用弓箭——弓是西班牙人帶進美洲的——而是使用矛投器配黑曜石或燧石矛頭的長矛，另有削出鋒刃的木劍與加長的棍棒；防護上則有棉花填充的衣甲，以及供美洲豹皮披掛的精銳戰士裝備。瓦卡與亞克奇蘭都是依山而建的台地城址，防守依靠石階、圍牆與神殿群的層層退守，奪城靠攀梯、火攻與精銳小隊突入上層建築區；攻下之後，馬雅式的勝利不是拆毀城池，而是帶走王室人質並扶植聽命的附庸。糧秣則靠蒂卡爾與亞克奇蘭之間水道上的獨木舟隊，以及王室與地方首領掌握的玉米倉庫來供應。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman scutum, and its place in this war has to be stated honestly: the scutum never existed in Mesoamerica, and not a single piece of Roman military equipment was present on any Petén battlefield in 378 AD. By way of comparison, the defensive equipment of the Maya warrior was a small round or oval hand shield, a frame of wooden slats and wicker covered with hide, sometimes with flakes of obsidian set into the rim, held in the hand to cover the upper body rather than the whole person. Set against the one-man-high convex rectangular shield of the Roman maniples, the difference lies not in workmanship but in the military system: the Romans interlocked shield rims into dense ranks and the testudo, whereas the Maya relied on tight formations of elite infantry and on the rhythm of their missile fire. For offence the Maya used no bows at all — the bow arrived in the Americas with the Spanish — but rather the atlatl with obsidian- or flint-tipped spears, plus flint-edged wooden swords and long clubs. For protection they used quilted cotton armour and the panelled hide gear of jaguar-padded elite warriors. Waka' and Yaxchilán were both hilltop terrace cities, defended by stone stairways, enclosure walls and tiered temple groups, and to take them the attackers used ladders, fire and small elite teams pushing into the upper precincts. What counted as victory in Maya terms was not the razing of the city but the removal of royal hostages and the installation of compliant clients. Supplies came by canoe along the waterways between Tikal and Yaxchilán and out of the maize stores held by the royal household and the local chiefs.
tactics: 馬雅人打仗先定日子，再定陣勢，這場戰爭尤其如此。所謂「星戰」，是依卓爾金曆與哈布曆的日名卜算後選定的出兵時辰，日期由祭司記在碑上，出兵的名號就以該日的星象與吉凶命名，領軍者藉此宣稱自己的行動得到宇宙秩序的背書。西亞吉·卡克把首戰放在旱季，直接指向亞克奇蘭位於烏蘇馬辛塔河谷的台地城。蒂卡爾距該城直線約一百公里，河道卻曲折數倍，聯軍主力沿水路推進，接近後才在岸上集結，以矛投器長矛齊射壓制台地邊緣，再由披戴美洲豹皮與棉花甲的精銳步兵攀梯攻入上層建築群。攻破之後蒂卡爾並未拆毀城，而是帶走王室人質、扶立附庸，讓亞克奇蘭繼續存在卻俯首聽命。次年兵鋒轉向瓦卡，那座核心區以百公頃計、三聯建築群高聳入雲的巨大都邑；此役之後瓦卡核心出現焚燒與放棄痕跡，碳十四定年把崩塌壓在公元四世紀末至五世紀初，與戰役時間互相吻合。多城邦聯軍同時在數處開闢戰線，以兵力與聲勢壓垮對手的盟約結構，用俘獲替代殲滅，用附庸體系取代直接佔領，這才是這場戰爭真正的戰術內核。
tacticsEn: The Maya chose the day before they chose the order of battle, and this war is a textbook case of it. A star war was a launch date fixed by the day-signs of the Tzolk'in and the Haab' through priestly divination; the date was carved on the monuments, the war was named after the auspices of that day, and the commander thereby claimed that heaven itself stood behind his campaign. Siyaj K'ak' put the first blow in the dry season and aimed it straight at the terrace city of Yaxchilán in the Usumacinta valley. Tikal lies about a hundred kilometres from that city in a straight line, but the river winds many times that distance, so the allied column advanced by water and only drew up on the bank to close up. Spear-thrower volleys brought the terrace edge under fire, and elite infantry wearing jaguar pelts and cotton armour went up the ladders into the upper precincts. Having taken the city, Tikal did not raze it: the royal hostages were carried off, clients were installed, and Yaxchilán continued to exist in a bowed posture. The following year the spearhead turned to Waka', the vast capital whose core covered hundreds of hectares and whose triadic complexes rose high above the forest. After that campaign the core of Waka' shows burning and abandonment, and radiocarbon dating places the collapse between the late fourth and the early fifth century AD, matching the campaign closely. The city-state league opened fronts in several places at once, breaking the opposing alliance structure by weight of numbers and momentum: captives instead of annihilation, a network of clients instead of outright annexation. That is the real tactical core of this war.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但幾個節點相當明確。戰爭始於公元378年、延續到379年，戰爭列表即以378至379年登錄；蒂卡爾與亞克奇蘭之間的直線距離約一百公里，沿烏蘇馬辛塔河的水路航程要遠得多。亞克奇蘭第11號石碑與第25號門楣記錄的人質身份可以與其他碑刻互相對證，但雙方出動的兵員規模沒有留下任何數字；學界對佩滕各城邦人口的估算差距極大，蒂卡爾在九世紀高峰期的估算多落在數萬人量級，公元378年時其城區規模顯著小於高峰，保守的說法是當時蒂卡爾能持續派出的兵員以數千計。亞克奇蘭第33號與第21號建築群在戰後仍持續興建，說明統治中心並未隨國王陣亡而中止運作。瓦卡方面的放棄有碳十四樣本支持，放棄時序落在公元四世紀末至五月初，與西亞吉·卡克在位約二十六年（378至404年前後）、蒂卡爾隨後兩三個世紀持續擴張的整體年表互相吻合。可以確定的還有：亞克奇蘭的球場石碑在三百多年後仍被重新雕刻，第11號石碑成於公元790年前後；西亞吉·卡克是已知最早使用「K'inich Yax Ahaw」尊號的蒂卡爾君主；佩滕北部的達利碑同樣以長曆日名記錄了一次「星戰」，是這類行動留下文字的少數實例。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, but several nodes are firm. The war began in 378 AD and ran into 379, and the war lists record it as 378–379. The straight-line distance between Tikal and Yaxchilán is about a hundred kilometres, and the real distance travelled up the Usumacinta is many times longer. The identities of the hostages on Yaxchilán Stela 11 and Lintel 25 can be cross-checked against other monuments, but no number survives for the size of either army. Estimates of the population of the Petén city-states vary enormously; Tikal at its ninth-century height is usually put at a figure in the tens of thousands, and in 378 its urban core was considerably smaller than that peak, so the conservative reading is that Tikal could keep only a few thousand men in the field. The Yaxchilán Structure 33 and Structure 21 groups continued to be built after the war, which shows that the seat of government did not stop functioning with the king's death. For Waka' the abandonment is supported by radiocarbon samples, which place it between the late fourth and the early fifth century AD, consistent with the reign of Siyaj K'ak' over roughly twenty-six years (378 to about 404) and with the two or three centuries of continued Tikal expansion that followed. Also certain: the Yaxchilán ballcourt stela was re-carved more than three centuries later, Stela 11 was made around 790 AD; Siyaj K'ak' is the earliest known ruler of Tikal to use the title K'inich Yax Ahaw; and the Dali Stela in northern Petén likewise records a star war by its Long Count day-sign, one of the few written traces of this kind of campaign.
cause: 戰爭的起因有三層。最表層是王位更替：公元378年蒂卡爾的舊王去世，年輕的西亞吉·卡克即位，他父親那一代的名號帶著特奧蒂瓦坎的地名（瓦哈特佩克），而蒂卡爾此後仍要面對各地「親特奧蒂瓦坎派」的守舊勢力；新王即位即改用與日月相關的神聖尊號，等於向舊秩序宣示血統與神授權威的轉移。第二層是區域權力真空：特奧蒂瓦坎自六世紀起在佩滕建立的代理網路，隨其本土政體衰退而瓦解，曾經的霸主瓦卡這時自身也瀕臨崩解，各城邦在沒有共同主人的狀態下重新排列聯盟，蒂卡爾則握有佩滕中部最大的人口與神廟資源。第三層是馬雅政治獨有的邏輯——神權與軍權不可分割，出兵時日必須合曆法，王位的正當性要靠神廟的占卜與戰果同時證明，因此一場勝仗既是宗教事件也是外交事件。鄰近的亞克奇蘭因為拒絕站隊而被選為第一個目標，瓦卡則是下一個必須被打掉的舊中心。
causeEn: The war had three layers of cause. The outermost was a change of kings: in 378 the old ruler of Tikal died and the young Siyaj K'ak' acceded, inheriting a father whose name carried a Teotihuacan toponym of the Waxtepec kind, and a kingdom that still had to face pro-Teotihuacan factions in several towns. The new king adopted a sacred title of solar and lunar character, and by that act announced a shift of bloodline and divine authority away from the old order. The second layer was a regional power vacuum: the network of proxies Teotihuacan had built in Petén since the sixth century was dissolving as its own polity declined, Waka', the former hegemon, was itself on the verge of collapse, the city-states were realigning their alliances in the absence of any common master, and Tikal held the largest population and the richest temple resources in central Petén. The third layer was the specifically Maya logic of politics, in which priestly and military power cannot be separated: the day of departure had to fit the calendar, and a king's legitimacy had to be proven at once by the divination in the temples and by the results of the campaign, so that a single victory was simultaneously a religious act and a diplomatic act. Neighbouring Yaxchilán, which declined to pick a side, was chosen as the first target, and Waka' was the next old centre that had to be broken.
impact: 這場戰爭的歷史意義遠大於戰術層面。公元378年之後，蒂卡爾成為佩滕低地毫無爭議的霸主，其王室的占卜記錄、節慶儀式與建築規模都遠超前代，先前默默無聞的佩滕東部城址一個接一個出現帶有蒂卡爾式樣的紀念碑；此後三百年間，蒂卡爾的附庸網絡一路延伸到烏蘇馬辛塔上游與洪都拉斯西部的貝利奧，前哨城市多斯皮拉斯也在公元六二九年前後被設立，成為日後引發蒂卡爾—多斯皮拉斯戰爭的源地。它的示範作用更在於把「星戰」這種把天文曆法與征服綁在一起的戰爭形式推廣到整個馬雅世界，愈到八、九世紀，愈多城邦的碑刻以卜算日名記錄出兵，聯盟戰爭與人質外交成為常態。代價同樣沉重：蒂卡爾自身在九至十世紀陷入崩解，亞克奇蘭在八世紀末之後逐步廢棄，佩滕的權力中心其後轉往北部低地與南部高地。今天的考古學界正是藉由瓦卡核心的崩塌時序，重新為古代中美洲的歷史分期，並認識到「星戰」並非神話式的儀式，而是真實存在過的、以日名為名、留下人質與附庸體系的軍事行動。
impactEn: The historical meaning of this war reaches far beyond its tactics. After 378, Tikal became the unchallenged hegemon of the Petén lowlands; its royal divinatory records, festival ritual and building programmes all ran ahead of anything earlier, and town after town in eastern Petén, previously obscure, began raising monuments in Tikal styles. Over the following three centuries the client network of Tikal reached up the Usumacinta and west into the Bee region of Honduras, and the forward base of Dos Pilas was established around 629 AD, later becoming the source of the Tikal-Dos Pilas wars. The model's influence was even greater: it spread across the whole Maya world the form of war that tied astronomical calendrics to conquest. The more the eighth and ninth centuries advanced, the more monuments recorded campaigns named by their divinatory day-sign, and league war and hostage diplomacy became the norm. The cost was equally heavy: Tikal itself broke down in the ninth and tenth centuries, Yaxchilán was progressively abandoned after the end of the eighth century, and the centre of gravity of Petén shifted to the northern lowlands and the southern highlands. Modern archaeology has used the dating of the collapse at Waka' to reshape the periodisation of ancient Mesoamerica, and has come to understand the star war not as a mythic ritual but as a real military action, named for its day-sign, that left hostages and client regimes behind.
result: 結果是明確的：公元378年亞克奇蘭被攻破，國王鳥美洲豹四世陣亡，年幼的王儲被俘，王室貴婦大頭顱與女兒同時被押走，亞克奇蘭從獨立的城邦變成蒂卡爾的附庸，王位換上聽命於蒂卡爾的本地貴族。次年，蒂卡爾的聯軍轉攻瓦卡，這座曾統治佩滕的巨型都邑在戰後陷入焚燒與放棄，其城邦體系隨之瓦解，佩滕的地權版圖被重新畫過。戰後西亞吉·卡克在蒂卡爾又統治了二十多年，把國家推向古典期的高峰，蒂卡爾第31號石碑與佩滕北部的達利碑共同把這場戰爭的日名與戰果留給了後世。亞克奇蘭本身並未因此消失，它在附庸的姿態下繼續運作，公元790年前後還刻出第11號石碑，記錄三百多年前的那場敗仗，門楣上的俘虜形象也成了古典期最著名的戰爭紀念像之一。對整個馬雅世界而言，378至379年被視為古典期的一個分水嶺：特奧蒂瓦坎的影子退去，佩滕的城邦第一次被一個王朝以人質與聯盟的方式捏合成體系，而這套體系終究在九世紀的普遍崩潰中解體。
resultEn: The outcome is clear. In 378 Yaxchilán was taken, King Bird Jaguar IV was killed, the boy prince was captured, and Lady Great Skull and a daughter were carried off; the independent city-state became a client of Tikal, and the throne passed to local nobles who answered to the king of Tikal. The following year the allied host turned on Waka'. After that campaign the great capital that had ruled Petén burned and was abandoned, its city-state system fell apart, and the map of power in Petén was redrawn. After the war Siyaj K'ak' ruled at Tikal for another twenty-odd years, driving the state towards the high point of the Classic period, and Tikal Stela 31 together with the Dali Stela in northern Petén handed down to later ages the day-sign and the results of this campaign. Yaxchilán itself did not disappear: it continued to function in the posture of a client, and around 790 AD it carved Stela 11 recording the defeat of three hundred years earlier, the captive on the lintel becoming one of the most famous war images of the Classic period. For the Maya world as a whole, 378–379 came to be seen as a watershed of the Classic period: the shadow of Teotihuacan withdrew, and for the first time the Petén city-states were welded into a single system by one dynasty through hostages and alliances, a system that would finally dissolve in the general collapse of the ninth century.
